usage: policy for webhooks directing to URLs with unknown VT reputation
name: Webhook URLs must not have unknown reputation
description: A webhook URL should not be unknown based on Virus Total reputation.
detailedDescription: An unknown destination webhook URL may have been planted during a breach to gain visibility in changes to your code and environments.

args.name: reputation
args.label: Reputation
args.tooltip: Select on or more Virus Total reputations to generate the policy
